info.name: AI MetroFlow - Backend API
info.description:
Full API collection for MetroFlow (metro-b-final backend). Covers all 17 route modules: Health, Auth, Stations, Trains, Scheduling, Crowd Monitoring, AI Prediction, Alerts & Notifications, Analytics, Meta, News, Enquiries, Check-in/Check-out, Users, and Admin.

SETUP:
1. Import the companion environment file (AI MetroFlow - Local.postman_environment.json).
2. Fill in base_url, supabase_url, supabase_anon_key, supabase_email, supabase_password.
3. Run '0. Auth (Supabase login) > Login' once - it auto-saves your access_token.
4. Every other request uses {{access_token}} as its Bearer token automatically (collection-level auth), except the ones explicitly marked No Auth (public routes).

item.name: 0. Auth (Supabase login)

request.description: Logs in directly against Supabase Auth (NOT this backend - MetroFlow's backend has no /login endpoint on purpose, see app/api/v1/authentication.py). Set supabase_url, supabase_anon_key, supabase_email, supabase_password in the environment first. Run this once - the Tests script auto-saves the returned access_token into {{access_token}}, which every other request in this collection uses as its Bearer token.
Verifies the access_token against this backend and returns/creates the app profile.

item.description: Run 'Login' first. Auth itself is handled entirely by Supabase - this backend only verifies the JWT.
